objective: Evaluate future-buyer identification at a fixed selection capacity; not intervention uplift.
status: Retrospective analysis plan fixed before running candidate-rule evaluation; not prospective preregistration.
eligible_pool: Observed before decision_date, no buy before decision_date, at least one fav/cart before decision_date.
broad_reference: All users observed before decision_date with no historical buy, regardless of intent.
outcome: At least one observed buy event in the subsequent two complete calendar days, any item.
selection: Maximize validation precision at primary_capacity; break rule ties by listed priority. Freeze selected rule before evaluating test and robustness windows.
user_tie_break: ascending deterministic BLAKE2b digest of taobao-offline-v1:user_id
main_baseline: Uniform random without replacement of same capacity from the same intent-eligible pool; exact expected positives k*M/N.
uncertainty: Hypergeometric simulation 2.5th/97.5th percentiles describes random-list variation conditional on observed pool labels, not a treatment-effect CI.
prohibited_claims: true platform-new users or first-ever purchasers
